text: Run multiple coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in parallel
quote: Conductor lets you run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode in parallel.

text: Each task runs in its own isolated workspace with dedicated branch, files, terminal, diff, and review path
quote: Each task gets its own workspace, branch, files, terminal, diff, and review path.

text: Save a loadout of favorite models and switch between them quickly, including keyboard shortcuts for model/effort/speed/order
quote: Pick a loadout of your favorite models to quickly switch between. It’s keyboard accessible too: change models (⌃⌘ 1-5), effort (⌘⇧/), speed (⌘⇧E) or model ordering (Tab, then space) without leaving your keyboard.

text: Run agents on a schedule or trigger them via a GitHub Action ('routines')
quote: Introducing routines! You can now run your agents on a schedule or via GitHub action.

text: Create private workspaces not shared with the rest of the team
quote: You can now create private workspaces that aren’t shared with the rest of your team.

text: Search file contents within a local project or cloud workspace
quote: Search file contents in your current local project or cloud workspace with ⌘⇧F.

text: Sign in with an existing Cursor subscription to use cloud workspaces
quote: Sign in to your Cursor subscription for cloud workspaces.

text: Edit attachments that are queued in messages before sending
quote: You can now edit attachments in queued messages.

text: Copy, save, download, or open images from chat previews
quote: Copy, save, download, or open images from chat previews, including expanded previews.

text: Enable exclusive port forwarding so only one workspace forwards ports at a time
quote: Enable Exclusive port forwarding in Settings → Ports to turn forwarding off in other workspaces whenever you turn it on in one.

text: View PR comments and failing check logs even while the cloud workspace is asleep
quote: PR comments and failing-check logs now load while a cloud workspace is asleep.

text: Create a new workspace directly from a branch, pull request, GitHub issue, or Linear issue
quote: Use Command + Shift + N or the `...` button next to `New workspace` to create a workspace from a branch, pull request, GitHub issue, or Linear issue.

text: Manage cloud workspaces programmatically via the Conductor API
quote: The Conductor API lets you manage cloud workspaces programmatically.

text: Hosted MCP server lets ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, and other MCP clients manage cloud workspaces
quote: Conductor's hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, and other MCP clients manage your cloud workspaces.

text: Share a link that opens a workspace in Conductor for any org member
quote: The link opens the workspace in Conductor for any member of the organization.

text: Reassign a workspace to make a teammate responsible for it
quote: Right-click the workspace and choose **Reassign to** to make a teammate responsible for it.

text: Agent can test repositories, update install/setup scripts, and run builds without confirming each step
quote: The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds — without asking you to confirm each step.

text: Checkpoints let you revert code and chat state to an earlier turn in a session
quote: Checkpoints | Session/workspace | Revert code and chat state to an earlier turn

text: Bring your own subscriptions and API keys to power agents
quote: Bring your own subscriptions and keys

text: Sandboxes spin up in seconds and agents keep working after you close your laptop
quote: Sandboxes spin up in seconds, and agents keep working after you close your laptop.
